evidence_corpus.content: Official Apple Guide (HT204051): If your iPhone or iPad won't connect to Wi-Fi, Bluetooth devices, or displays 'No Service': Toggle Airplane Mode on and off. For Bluetooth, tap Forget This Device and pair again. If issues persist, go to Settings > General > Reset > Reset Network Settings.

Official Apple Guide (HT201557): For cracked screen repair, accidental physical damage, liquid contact, or camera/speaker hardware service, schedule an appointment at an Apple Store Genius Bar or Apple Authorized Service Provider via getsupport.apple.com or the Apple Support app.

Official Apple Guide: For personalized technical assistance, account security review, or hardware inspection, reach out directly to an Apple Support specialist via DM or schedule an appointment at getsupport.apple.com.

Official Apple Guide (HT204084): To request a refund for an App Store or iTunes purchase, sign in to reportaproblem.apple.com with your Apple ID. Select 'I'd like to', choose 'Request a refund', select the reason, and submit. For subscription cancellations, go to Settings > [Your Name] > Subscriptions.

Official Apple Guide (HT204204): If your iPhone or iPad won't update: Verify you have sufficient free storage in Settings > General > iPhone Storage. Ensure you are connected to a stable Wi-Fi network and charger. If the update is corrupted, go to Settings > General > Storage, find the iOS update file, delete it, and download again.

Official Apple Guide (HT201487): If you forgot your Apple ID password or your account is locked: Go to iforgot.apple.com to reset your password. If using two-factor authentication, you can reset from a trusted Apple device via Settings > [Your Name] > Password & Security > Change Password.

Official Apple Guide (HT201412): If your iPhone is frozen or won't turn on: On iPhone 8 or later, quickly press and release Volume Up, then Volume Down, then press and hold the Side button until the Apple logo appears. Connect to power and allow to charge for at least an hour.

Official Apple Guide (HT208387): To maximize battery life and lifespan, avoid extreme ambient temperatures. Go to Settings > Battery to view Battery Health and app usage. If Maximum Capacity is significantly degraded or Peak Performance is compromised, contact Apple Support for authorized battery replacement.
